caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object resembling an ornate hook and a stand, rendered in colored pencil or similar medium. The upper part of the object consists of a curved, hook-shaped piece that is shaded in tones of gray and outlined in black, with a noticeable highlight suggesting a metallic surface. The hook is attached to a triangular component with three circular holes near its top edge, and a downward-facing point at the bottom. This triangular piece is connected by a joint to an arched, pipe-like structure, also shaded in gray. The arched structure extends downward and is mounted on an irregularly shaped, flat base with rounded edges, shaded in varying grays and blues to indicate depth and shadow. The background is plain, with only minimal horizontal pink and purple lines behind the upper part of the hook, and there is a thin, lightly drawn rectangular border enclosing the composition. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Lamp
